environment.browser: Chromium with Playwright persistent context and Service Workers enabled
environment.profile: Temporary isolated browser profile; did not reuse or alter the user's existing Chrome profile
environment.existingPreview: http://127.0.0.1:4173 remained listening throughout this check

commandOrSteps: Start the application in mock mode on the isolated origin http://127.0.0.1:4174 and open /w/auth/login in a persistent Chromium browser context.
Wait until the Service Worker is activated; read navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations() from the page on that origin and record the scope and script URL.
Stop only the isolated Vite server, restart it in API mode on the same host and port, and load /w/auth/login in the same page and browser context.

Wait for API-mode bootstrap and its automatic reload; read registrations again from the same origin and inspect the rendered login UI. Do not unregister workers manually and do not submit credentials or trade actions.
expected: The mock-mode page has an active /mockServiceWorker.js registration. After API-mode bootstrap on the same origin, the old registration is gone, and mock-only warnings, hints, and controls are absent.

supplementalVisualCheck.result: Login screen rendered without mock warning, demo hints, or preview controls.
supplementalVisualCheck.inputValues: Email and password fields had zero entered characters; the password placeholder is decorative.

safetyAndScope.notes: The local API endpoint was intentionally unavailable. This observation certifies only same-origin worker retirement and API-mode UI bootstrap. The static mockServiceWorker.js asset remains tracked separately by C04.02; real backend/staging behavior is still unverified.
